title: Malaysian Fish Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy fish curry dish inspired by the cuisine of Malaysia. The combination of coconut milk, curry, and fish creates a rich and savory taste experience.

ingredients.name: Curry paste
ingredients.notes: Choose a mild or spicy curry paste according to your preference

ingredients.name: Coconut milk
ingredients.notes: Full-fat coconut milk for richer flavor

ingredients.name: Quintessential soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Or substitute with regular soy sauce

ingredients.name: Malaysian chili peppers
ingredients.notes: Sliced or chopped for added heat

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the fish pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 3-4 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk, soy sauce, and fish sauce (if using). Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium-low.
Add sliced chili peppers and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over steamed rice or noodles.
